_note: The photos on /gallery that aren't food from the menu: catering spreads and the cafe itself. Food photos are in src/_data/photos.json. Images live in src/assets/gallery/ (the storefront-at-sunset photo is src/assets/photos/storefront.jpg, shared with the newspaper piece) as web copies: at most about 2000px, camera and GPS data stripped. After adding one, run `npm run thumbs` for the gallery's small copy. `caption` is the short name shown under the tile; `alt` says what is in the picture, for screen readers. The tiles are cropped to 4:3, and `position` (a CSS object-position) keeps the subject in the crop; a tap opens the whole photo. No people: the staff do not want photos of themselves online.
